name: AWS Lambda

evidence.paas: 03: AWS runs uploaded event and web functions as managed compute

line: Run event functions or HTTP applications on managed AWS compute.

free.text: Event functions: 1 million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds monthly

cells.regions: AWS regions; Web Functions in five regions

work.math: Lambda storage is limited to code and execution files. A separate S3 + CloudFront example is not a price for hosting on Lambda.
1 million requests and 62,500 GB-seconds fit within the unused monthly allowances of 1 million and 400,000 GB-seconds. Assumes logs and request transfer stay free.
The small app API cost, plus $13.98 a month for RDS compute and 20 GB of storage. Backup excess, CPU credits, network path and logs vary.
